categories.name: Bounce Houses
categories.blurb: Castles and bright jumpers for backyard birthdays.
categories.intro: Every bounce house is washed, inspected and staked down by our crew. Prices include delivery inside 10 miles, setup, and pickup the same evening.

categories.name: Combos
categories.blurb: Bounce, climb and slide in one unit.
categories.intro: Combos pack a jump area, a climbing wall and a slide into one footprint, so older kids stay busy longer. Most fit a 30 ft yard.

categories.name: Water Slides
categories.blurb: Tall slides and splash pools for hot days.
categories.intro: Water slides need a garden hose within 50 ft and a lawn that can take some water. We set the pool level and test the flow before we leave.

categories.name: Active Play
categories.intro: Built for field days, church festivals and kids who never stop moving. Each one keeps a line of kids rotating fast.

categories.name: Tents
categories.blurb: Frame tents and canopies for shade or rain.
categories.intro: Frame tents need no center poles, so the space under them stays open. We stake into grass or use water barrels on hard surfaces.

categories.name: Tables & Chairs
categories.blurb: Banquet and round tables, white chairs, kids sets.
categories.intro: Tables and chairs are priced per day and delivered stacked where you choose. Add linens to any table.

categories.name: Concessions
categories.blurb: Cotton candy, popcorn and snow cones, supplies included.
categories.intro: Each machine comes with supplies for 50 servings and a one-page guide. Most run on one standard outlet.

categories.name: Yard Games
categories.intro: Giant yard games keep adults and kids playing between the bigger rentals. They fit in a car, so pickup from our warehouse is free.

cityNotes.Springfield: Our warehouse is on Market Street, so most Springfield orders arrive at the start of the delivery window.
cityNotes.Riverside: Riverside yards tend to be flat and open, which suits the larger combos and the climbing tower.
cityNotes.Fairview: Many Fairview homes have gated side yards. Measure the gate: most inflatables need a 4 ft opening.
cityNotes.Oakdale: Oakdale schools book the climbing tower and caterpillar crawl for field day in May, so reserve early.
cityNotes.Lakewood: Lakewood lake-house parties often need a generator. Add one on the product page.
cityNotes.Greenville: Greenville sits at the edge of our area, 29 miles out, so delivery is $38. Bundle a package to make the trip worth it.

faqs.a: $50 or 25% of your order, whichever is higher. The balance is charged 2 days before your event.
If rain or wind over 15 mph is forecast, cancel up to 2 hours before delivery for a full refund or credit. We never set up inflatables in unsafe weather.

faqs.q: How much space do I need?
faqs.a: Each item lists its setup area, which already includes room to walk around it. Measure gates too: most inflatables need a 4 ft opening.
Most inflatables need 1 standard outlet within 50 ft, on its own circuit. No outlet nearby? Add a generator for $85 on the product page.
Cancel 7 or more days before your event for a full refund. Inside 7 days, your deposit becomes store credit for 12 months.

faqs.q: When do you deliver and pick up?
faqs.a: For daytime events we deliver between 8 am and 12 pm and pick up by 8 pm. We text when the crew is 30 minutes away.

faqs.q: Can you set up on concrete or a driveway?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose Hard surface in the cart and we bring sandbags instead of stakes for $25 per inflatable or tent.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home for delivery?
faqs.a: Someone 18 or older needs to be there to show us where to set up and to hear the safety rules. Pickup can happen without you.

faqs.q: How do you clean the equipment?
faqs.a: Every inflatable is swept, washed and sanitized after each rental, then left to dry fully before it goes back on the shelf.
Yes, with $1 million in general liability coverage. Schools, churches and venues can request a certificate of insurance at checkout.

faqs.q: Can I keep a rental overnight?
faqs.a: Yes. Pick Overnight on the product page and we pick up the next morning by 10 am.

faqs.q: Do you deliver outside your area?
faqs.a: We deliver up to 30 miles from Springfield. For anything farther, call us and we will quote it.
